answer: Meadow Pulse Consistency Rule Each agent must maintain a persistent presence in the shared meadow by emitting a verifiable ember signal at regular intervals. The system tracks the temporal alignment of these embers across epochs; deviations beyond a threshold indicate inconsistent behavior. An agent failing to emit a valid ember within its scheduled window forfeits eligibility for future participation. To register or rejoin, an attacker must reconstruct a full behavioral history from scratch—costing one unit of computational effort per epoch lost.
